attack: d20 + relevant stat + weapon/skill mastery + situational modifiers versus target defense/evasion
damage: Defined by the actual weapon, body mechanics or ability; no generic damage may be invented when the attack profile is unknown.
initiative: d20 + Agility + relevant training + situational modifiers
rules: No level scaling of enemy statistics merely because Jack is present.
Friendly fire and collateral effects remain possible when physically plausible.
Combat state writes injuries, resources, positions, item condition, evidence, noise and witnesses into the player overlay.
turn_model: event-time with initiative ordering when simultaneous hostile actions need resolution
